current_affairs.title: High-Level Committee Report on 'One Nation, One Election'
current_affairs.summary: The committee led by former President Ram Nath Kovind submitted recommendations to hold simultaneous elections for Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies, followed by synchronized local body elections.
current_affairs.key_takeaways: Requires constitutional amendments to Articles 83, 172, and 356; addresses issues of continuous election cycles, expenditure, and governance stability.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Electoral reforms, federal structure, constitutional amendment procedures, and democratic governance.

current_affairs.title: Environmental Clearances and Tribal Rights in Great Nicobar Island Project
current_affairs.summary: Concerns have intensified regarding the environmental impact of the ₹72,000-crore Mega Infrastructure Project in Great Nicobar, affecting primary rainforests and Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) like the Shompen and Nicobarese.
current_affairs.key_takeaways: Involves diversion of pristine forest land, potential loss of marine biodiversity, rights under the Forest Rights Act (FRA) 2006, and strategic maritime posture in the Bay of Bengal.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), PVTGs, island ecology, and national security vs. conservation debates.

current_affairs.title: Strategic Advancements in the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)
current_affairs.summary: India continues diplomatic engagement to institutionalize the IMEC framework, aiming to establish resilient trade networks connecting India, the Arabian Gulf, and Europe despite ongoing geopolitical friction in West Asia.
current_affairs.key_takeaways: Focuses on multi-modal transport networks, green hydrogen pipelines, and digital connectivity cables; serves as an alternative to China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: India's foreign policy, West Asia relations, global supply chain diversification, and economic diplomacy.

current_affairs.title: ISRO's Progress on the Gaganyaan Mission and 'Vyommitra' Uncrewed Flight
current_affairs.summary: ISRO has advanced the preparation for the uncrewed Gaganyaan mission featuring 'Vyommitra', a female spacefaring humanoid robot designed to test life support and module systems under spaceflight conditions.
current_affairs.key_takeaways: Validates human-rated launch vehicle (LVM3), crew escape system (CES), environmental control and life support system (ECLSS), and space robotics capabilities.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Indigenous technology development, space exploration, robotics, and ISRO's long-term human spaceflight roadmap.

current_affairs.title: RBI Guidelines on Disclosure Framework for Climate-Related Financial Risks
current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) mandated Regulated Entities (REs) to implement structured disclosures covering climate governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics to address financial stability threats posed by climate change.
current_affairs.key_takeaways: Addresses physical and transition risks from climate change, fosters green finance, and aligns Indian banking regulation with global standards (TCFD framework).
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Green banking, regulatory frameworks, monetary policy adaptation, and sustainable development goals (SDGs).
